text_block_list.text: The day of the Queen Elizabeth II Cup—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"No, for real, Loves Only You is the one! 
With today's lineup, she's definitely 
taking it!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Still, Chrono Genesis is really consistent 
too~. And there's Lucky Lilac from the 
class above her, so who knows how it'll 
go—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah. Feels like I can give it my all 
today...!

Loves Only You managed to recover from her 
injury and safely made it to race day. All 
that's left now is to send her off.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it came as quite a surprise. It 
seems our pre-race evaluations were 
actually pretty high..."
choice_data_list:
It just means you've put in that kind of 
running, huh.

It just means you've put in that kind of 
running, doesn't it.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ I hope the community members feel 
proud of it too.

I can say that for certain. Because right 
now, at this very moment, I am filled with 
immense pride for the girl standing before 
me.

Even so, today's Queen Elizabeth II Cup 
will likely be the toughest race yet. The 
reason being—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...It's because you're running against 
Senior Class Umamusume, right?

"Compared to Classic Class Umamusume, 
those in the Senior Class have far more 
refined bodies, technique, and mental 
fortitude."

Above all, the one to watch out for this 
time would be Lucky Lilac, who is from the 
generation just above Loves Only You.

From the same generation as Almond Eye, 
she is a formidable competitor with the 
track record to prove it—having once won 
the honor of Best Junior Class Queen 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, Trainer-kun. After all, I'm an 
Umamusume who's about to take on the 
world!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, Trainer-chan. After all, I'm 
an Umamusume who's about to take on the 
world!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'll get solid results and show everyone. 
That Loves Only You is already one of the 
top Tiara Umamusume in the country♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Hehe♪ That's my line♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Is the air... kind of tense...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(...Is this intimidation? The whole 
paddock feels a bit heavy, or rather—)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Is this... the kind of pressure 
senior-class girls exert...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
――...It looks like Love-chan feels it too, 
doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...The presence of everyone in the Senior 
Class.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...It's amazing, isn't it? To this 
extent, even.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
For an Umamusume who runs in races... a 
single year is extraordinarily dense.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The Senior Class runners... In that gap of 
more than a year between us, they have 
accumulated an immense amount of 
experience...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Surely this is... the weight of it all, 
isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪ Hearing it put that way feels super 
lovely, but if I let my guard down, I feel 
like I'll start trembling...!

—In times like that, ya just gotta take a 
deep breath.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
It'll make it easier to blend into the 
atmosphere here.

text_block_list.name: Loves & Chrono
text_block_list.text: Miss Lala...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Here. Deep breath in, and out.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: *inhale*... *exhale*...――

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much, Lala-san.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
All that restless buzzing inside me... 
feels like it's settled down, just a 
little.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, as expected. You fit right in so 
quickly, I'm genuinely impressed. In that 
case—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: All that's left is for us to run together.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(What incredible intensity...! I almost 
forgot to breathe...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Let's both do our best out there. Looking 
forward to running with you today.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's just what I was hoping 
for...! Because today, I came here to show 
everyone what my running is made of...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
......That's great. Looks like you're 
raring to go.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'd better give it my all too 
so I don't lose. Make sure you watch my 
run closely, alright?
